capabilities: convert Chinese punctuation to English as you type
convert punctuation in the whole active file via ribbon button
convert punctuation in selected text via context menu
customize individual conversion rules in settings
extras: Also installable via the BRAT plugin using the repository Enthusjast/obsidian-punctuation-converter.
problem: Typing with a Chinese input method inserts full-width punctuation marks that users may want as standard English punctuation.
summary: Punctuation converter that turns Chinese punctuation into English equivalents in real time as you type, with bulk and selection conversion commands.
